record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of this peptide most resembles (38.5% similarity) Brevinin-1SN1. Identified from an animal regarded as a model for the ancestor of all vertebrates. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 6.3 ug/ml), V. anguillarum ATCC 43308, S. aureus ATCC 25923, and M. luteus ATCC 49732 (MIC 6.3-12.5 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: It showed no hemolysis of human RBCs at 100 ug/ml (less hemo.lytic). Structure: Helical in the presence of SDS or 50% TFE. MOA:bacteria: It binds to LPS or LTA. The peptide permeated bacterial membranes. Updated 6/2025
